propositions: Core commands across _commands, _engine_support, and _io modules currently parse argv imperatively with no reusable grammar definitions, creating duplication between runtime handlers and documentation.
Each core Route must wire its command's argparse factory via parser_factory field and route its _dispatch_* handler through that factory, eliminating parallel imperative grammar.
Per-command parser factories must preserve existing unknown-token semantics (skip vs reject-exit-2) and global flag extraction order, proven via negative tests per command family.

Parser factories must import no domain executor or optional dependency, and selected execution must resolve no unrelated parser or handler, verified by construction-exclusion and dispatch-isolation assertions.

Accepted/rejected argv matrices must cover missing/surplus arguments, space/equal options, --, global output extraction, and malformed input across all 49 core commands via real subprocess production-path tests.
